{{Quote|Gina is a native of Malthor, and she thinks we don't know that she spent some time running guns during the Medepiest Uprising. Fortunately, she survived that ill-timed battle and returned to her homeworld intact.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to Reginna Bel Typolla|<ref name="CRO" />}}
The '''Medepiest Uprising''' occurred at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and involved the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the uprising, [[Reginna Bel Typolla]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] before eventually returning to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Malthor]]. Typolla subsequently falsely believed that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] did not know of her involvement in the conflict.

==The uprising==
The Medepiest Uprising was a conflict<ref name="CRO" /> that took place at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Medepiest system/Legends|Medepiest system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The uprising involved the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and it also saw the participation of the [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Reginna Bel Typolla]]. After spending an amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] smuggling [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] during the conflict, the latter safely returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Malthor]],<ref name="CRO" /> in the Mid Rim's [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]].<ref name="EAOC Malthor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Malthor system/Legends|Malthor system]]</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We don't think the Empire knows she was involved in the Uprising, but, then, she doesn't think we know.|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to Reginna Bel Typolla|<ref name="CRO" />}}
Typolla eventually began relaying information to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and falsely believed that the Alliance was not aware of her involvement in the Medepiest Uprising. Not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] noted that fact in an entry dedicated to Typolla that was part of a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] detailing various Rebel operatives. Cracken further expressed his belief that the Empire, in turn, did not know of Typolla's participation in the uprising&mdash;which he considered to have been an "ill-timed" conflict&mdash;although he was not sure of that.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Medepiest Uprising was created by [[Ed Stark|Ted Stark]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" />
